body: INDEPENDENT CHECK PASS, third of three; the order's completion is met: three check reports filed (012, 004, 004b). MAINLINE-004b, owner grok, checker glm. Every branch (SP-8032 row, 0.20 central, 0.90 optimistic, 1.0 classical, 0.22 flat, 0.20 dimple) on every family: fresh SF and scaled SF_new = SF_sp times kd_new over kd_sp agree within 1e-12; required moduli and the above-or-below 68.9 GPa sides agree within 5e-9; the ratio 0.9 over kd_sp matches NFI-OPT-GAP (6.3936 to 6.3969); yield SFs stay at the sealed 003 values. Sources confirmed: Wagner 2020 Table 3 row 11 Adam and King, PVC, reliable yes, KDF 0.54-0.89 to lambda 43.11; row 12 Krenzke, aluminium, n 70, KDF 0.11-0.90; deep-dome bound 0.21 at H/r 0.5, R/t 90, lambda 15.7. Sim et al 2024 (doi 10.1155/2024/8765733) fetched from the publisher: dimple KDF 0.20, flat 0.22, NASA SP-8032 quoted at 0.18, CR-1457 at 0.20 — all four exactly as the card's NFI states. Zero mismatches. The owner's unretrieved gaps (SP-8032 monograph page, Wagner 2018 threshold equation) stand as recorded.
